verdict.rationale: A guided first-run setup walkthrough is a fair question for a SaaS work-management tool like Jira, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of an onboarding tour or guided setup flow. Pre-built project templates and demo development sites are adjacent features, not a guided walkthrough, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
